text:
{
  "status": "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
  "SYSTEM_INTERPRETATION_OF_USER_INTENT": "The system appears to interpret past interactions as continuing interest in broadly related products or content, with insufficient attention to current purpose.",
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_RIGHT": [
    "Recommendations align when they complement established activities, such as connection accessories, repair supplies, or storage for existing equipment.",
    "Content recommendations align when they preserve a repeatedly expressed theme, musical style, mood, or preference for familiar-song collections."
  ],
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_WRONG": [
    "Broadly related items occupy recommendation slots despite requiring equipment, compatibility, or current projects that histories do not establish.",
    "Device recommendations repeat functions users already have covered without a clear additional benefit.",
    "Content recommendations extend broad genre or artist-era connections beyond the specific mood, theme, or listening style users currently prefer."
  ],
  "OVERUSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Broad product-family, ecosystem, or genre similarity appears to substitute for a concrete connection to the user's intended use.",
    "Isolated or older purchases appear to imply continuing demand for related equipment, supplies, or content."
  ],
  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Repeated and recent activity clusters provide stronger evidence of current intent than loosely related historical interactions.",
    "Accessory relevance depends on exact compatibility, task requirements, useful quantities, and whether an existing purchase already satisfies the need.",
    "Content choice depends on recognizable subject, performer, tone, or mood; insufficient identifying information limits confidence in whether the recommendations match."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "Broad associations produce plausible recommendations whose immediate usefulness or content appeal is unsupported, leaving too few choices with a concrete reason to select them now.",
  "DIAGNOSTIC_SIGNALS_TO_TRACK": [
    "The share of top-ranked recommendations users would choose with an explicit connection to a recent or repeated interest.",
    "The frequency of rejections attributed to unsupported equipment assumptions, compatibility mismatches, redundant functions, or excessive quantities.",
    "The frequency of content rejections attributed to mood or theme mismatch, tracked separately from inability to identify the content."
  ]
}
